name: aspnet-api
title: ASP.NET Core API
blurb: .NET 8 minimal API: pure counting core, JSON routes, WebApplicationFactory HTTP tests, 422/404 as contract

verify.name: http
verify.cmd:
dotnet bin/Debug/net8.0/{{ npm_name }}.dll --urls http://127.0.0.1:5199 >.aspnet.log 2>&1 & srv=$!; ok=1; for _ in $(seq 1 120); do if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5199/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok=0; break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; if [ $ok -ne 0 ]; then cat .aspnet.log; kill $srv 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi; body=$(curl -fsS 'http://127.0.0.1:5199/stats?text=hello%20world%0A'); post=$(curl -fsS -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"text":"a b
c
"}' http://127.0.0.1:5199/stats); missing=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' http://127.0.0.1:5199/stats); unknown=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:5199/nope); kill $srv 2>/dev/null; wait $srv 2>/dev/null; rm -f .aspnet.log; printf 'get=%s
post=%s
missing=%s unknown=%s
' "$body" "$post" "$missing" "$unknown"; test "$missing" = 422; test "$unknown" = 404; echo "$body" | grep -q '"lines":1'; echo "$body" | grep -q '"bytes":12'; echo "$post" | grep -q '"lines":2'; echo "$post" | grep -q '"words":3'
